01 / ABOUT

People, process,
and the technical detail.

I work where security strategy meets the day-to-day reality of getting things done.

At Peloton, I lead GRC work across AI governance, third-party risk, PCI DSS, SOC 2, and enterprise risk. I work with engineering, legal, privacy, procurement, and business teams to turn requirements into processes people can actually use.

Outside work, I built DairyHisab, a free web app for small dairy farmers. It grew from a practical problem: accounting errors and the effort of keeping daily records by hand.
